messages.author: Ayesha Fatima
messages.body:
Dear All,
i have installed Amber 18 and AmberTools18 on WSL Ubuntu 18.04.
After installation it gives me this error
==============================================================
/home/khanlab/Documents/amber18/src/Makefile not found, or -noamber was set.
This is expected if you do not have Amber18.
===============================================================
I checked the amber18/src folder. there is only 1 file there "configure.h" .
I have already set the amber environment in .bashrc file and sourced it.
Any input on the matter is appreciated.
Thank you

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Thu, Apr 22, 2021, Ayesha Fatima wrote:
>
>==============================================================
>/home/khanlab/Documents/amber18/src/Makefile not found, or -noamber was set.
>This is expected if you do not have Amber18.
>===============================================================
This message indicates that you have AmberTools, but not Amber itself.
If you have an Amber18.tar.bz2 file, you need to extract that into your
amber18 folder.
If you don't have such a tar file, then you would need to visit
https://ambermd.org/GetAmber.php#amber
for more information.
....regards...dac

messages.author: Ayesha Fatima
messages.body:
